verdict.rationale: First-party upload docs say Claude accepts JPEG, PNG, GIF and WebP images, and that users can paste images straight from the clipboard, which covers sharing screenshots. They also say Claude analyzes visual elements such as images, charts and graphics within PDFs. missing for 10: evidence of interpretation accuracy (no hands-on or independent corroboration), explicit documentation of photo capture/sharing from mobile, any description of what the assistant reliably extracts from images (e.g., text/OCR, UI elements)
